summary: Completed comprehensive testing of RazorStitch recovery console after RazorSense redesign. Backend APIs fully functional (20/20 tests passed). Frontend mostly functional with excellent responsive design. All critical features working: console header (vital-top-bar correctly removed), auto-play, policy brain with DQN, timeline sync, dock controls, SSE streaming, responsive layouts.

design_issues.issue: Ghost run path hover is blocked by overlapping transparent path elements - hover timeout after 30s
